item.tib: stag ri rong gi skong mdos snang srid re skong
item.coloph: zhang zhung gshen po gyer spungs kyis phyi rabs don du mdzad/ de nas bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dus su/ khod spungs dran pa bdag gis gter du sbas/ phyi rabs las can kha gsal la khong dam pa gcig gis rnyed par shog rnyed nas 'gro don byed par shog gsang rgya/ gab rgya/ sbas rgya/ rgya gsum gyis gdab ste sbas so/ phyis su dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis gser zhal phyes te/ shog dril dmar ser gur ram mdog can la zhal bshus so/ de nas stag btsun gyis rim gyis brgyud nas/ tre ston phun tshogs grags pa nas/ be ri smon lam gyis phyag bris bu la phabs pa'i dpe' la zhal bshus so//

item.tib: stag ri rong gi skong mdos snang srid re skong
item.coloph: ma 'ongs phyi rabs don ched du/ gyer spungs bdag gis ye ger btab/ 'phel 'gribs dus su gter du sbas las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog 'phrad nas 'gro don byed par shog sa ma yaH rgya rgya rgya u ya ag thamaH gyer ri nem seg lku rgyud lo//
